definition: Core formulas for weight management and body composition

formulas.name: Body Mass Index
formulas.purpose: Estimate body weight relative to height.
limitations: BMI is a screening tool, not a measure of body fat.

formulas.name: Minimum Healthy Weight
formulas.purpose: Estimate minimum healthy weight range using BMI 18.5.

formulas.name: Maximum Healthy Weight
formulas.purpose: Estimate maximum healthy weight range using BMI 24.9.

formulas.name: Target Weight Difference
formulas.purpose: Determine the amount of change required.

formulas.name: Estimated Body Fat %
formulas.purpose: Estimate body fat percentage when direct measurement is unavailable.
limitations: This is an estimate, not a direct measurement.

formulas.name: Basal Metabolic Rate
formulas.purpose: Estimate daily energy required at complete rest.
assumptions: Height in meters, converted to cm internally

formulas.name: Total Daily Energy Expenditure
formulas.purpose: Estimate daily energy expenditure based on activity.
assumptions: Activity multiplier matches standard clinical brackets

formulas.name: Daily Calorie Target
formulas.purpose: Provide a personalised calorie target based on the selected weight goal.
assumptions: Standard 500 kcal deficit/surplus for moderate change

formulas.name: Daily Protein Goal
formulas.purpose: Estimate daily protein needs based on the user's goal.

formulas.name: Healthy Weight Progress Timeline
formulas.purpose: Estimate a realistic timeframe based on target weight difference.
assumptions: Assumes ~0.75kg per week rate of change
